definitionZh: @ supports CSS at- rule 允许您指定依赖于浏览器支持 CSS 特性的 CSS 声明 。 使用此规则通常称为特性查询. 该规则必须置于您的代码的顶端, 或嵌入其他有条件的组在规则中 。
sourceDefinition: The @supports CSS at-rule lets you specify CSS declarations that depend on a browser's support for CSS features. Using this at-rule is commonly called a feature query. The rule must be placed at the top level of your code or nested inside any other conditional group at-rule.
